title: Computer dives
intro: Import a file into this diver’s personal computer history.
formats: UDDF, Subsurface XML and the labeled CSV template. Vendor exports have not yet been verified.
keepZone: Keep the source timezone or mark it unknown
confirmTarget: I confirm the selected dives belong to
error: Couldn’t complete this action. Check your files and access, then try again.
limit: Up to 5 files, 2 MB each. Files are read for this import and are not saved.
previewOnly: Nothing is saved until you confirm the selected dives.
fileError: This file could not be read.
offsetHint: Use a fixed offset only when you know it. During daylight saving changes, verify which offset applied.
selectionHint: Exact duplicates stay in history; possible duplicates require your review.

warningCodes.timezone_unknown: Timezone unknown; the local clock is preserved.
warningCodes.profile_absent: This record has no depth profile.
warningCodes.multiple_recordings: This dive has multiple computer recordings.

fileErrorCodes.unsupported_fit: FIT import is not available yet.
fileErrorCodes.unsafe_xml: XML declarations or entities are not accepted.
fileErrorCodes.limit_exceeded: The file exceeds the import limits.
fileErrorCodes.invalid_reference: The file contains an unresolved reference.
